messages:
Maya - Recruiting: Heads up 
Oliver Chen's onsite proposed for Wed 10/6, 09:30-13:00 PT. He's flying in same day and asked about a quiet prep room.
Dan - Eng Manager: Sounds good. Who's on the loop?
Maya - Recruiting: 09:30 intro + team fit (Maya), 10:00 system design (Dan), 10:45 take-home walkthrough (Zoe), 11:30 manager + comp (Hiring Manager), 12:00 lunch debrief.
Zoe - SWE: I'll be remote. Please add Zoom for my slot.
Maya - Recruiting: Zoom link in invites; adding Conf E as backup for overflow.
Priya - People Ops: Travel note: we reimburse ground transport or parking up to $30. I sent Oliver the form. Also reserving Quiet Room 1 08:50-09:25 for prep.
frontdesk-bot: Visitor badge created for Oliver Chen, VIS-9180. Pickup at Main Desk.
Maya - Recruiting: Candidate requests vegetarian lunch and a short 10-min break halfway through. OK?
Dan - Eng Manager: Fine with me. We can shift slots by 10 mins.
Zoe - SWE: I'll join Zoom 10 min early to test screen share.
Maya - Recruiting: Candidate may arrive up to 20 mins late due to flight. If so we'll slide schedule and notify interviewers. Calendar updated to include 30 min buffer at end.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "Oliver Chen - Onsite Loop" with rooms, Zoom, accessibility notes.
Priya - People Ops: Quick reminder: post-interview please submit feedback in Greenhouse within 48hrs. I'll send a reminder email morning after.
Maya - Recruiting: Thanks all. I'll DM Oliver the building map and pick-up instructions today.
